The tiny native images establish identity; cyan and black are background, not character. Produce one full-body FRONT THREE-QUARTER view on genuine transparent background, 1024x1536 portrait, near orthographic camera chest height, even soft studio illumination, no floor, no cast shadow, no text. Heavyset adult male town merchant, broad stocky torso with round belly, shoulders still broad, short stout legs, round pale face, small eyes, clean shaven, short dark brown hair and plain low cylindrical muted grey cap. Long dark forest green plain wool tunic to below knees, long sleeves, restrained brown/gold binding at collar shoulder seams sleeve cuffs and hem; blue collar inset; broad charcoal belt with simple pale metal clasp, tan leather pouch on anatomical RIGHT hip (image left in front). Brown simple boots. Preserve native proportions and dark tonal weight. Neutral A-pose: arms 35 degrees away from vertical, straight relaxed wrists, open hands with five clearly separated fingers each, legs separated naturally. Model all sides consistently with source. Omit the hanging wooden club ONLY because that will be a separate prop; retain the hip pouch. High definition face and realistic cloth surface texture with broad shallow folds, plain undecorated medieval clothing, no embroidery, no armour, no extra accessories. Entire cap hands boots visible with generous margins.
references_hd_historical.reason: Faithful stocky proportions, face, cap, tunic and right pouch; alpha verified. Club excluded for separate modelling.
